senses.gloss: f. (preced.; cmp. Arab. ḳurd, ricinus) [scraping,] abdominal pain caused by a parasitic worm.
units: Lev. R. s. 18; Num. R. s. 7 (ref. to לזרא, Num. XI, 20) [read:] לק׳ שאהיה נותן דורא במעיהן (some ed. לקדרא) it will cause ḳurda, as I will put a parasite (dura) in their bowels; v. דְּרַרְיָא.
